title: Freelancer or consultant
summary: Sell your expertise: a clear way to book an intro call, what you offer and roughly what it costs, proof from past clients.

for: Freelance designers, developers, writers and marketers
notFor: Agencies with a team page to show (start from small-business)

cards.purpose: The one action a prospect should take.
What they sell, each with a format and a starting price.
Case studies, if they can share any.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a square photo or logo for your profile picture?
slots.write: The member uploads it in the editor; never fetch one from the web.

slots.ask: How should a new client start: a booking link for an intro call, email, or both?
slots.write: The first button is the booking link (bookCall preset) when they have one. Email: Only an address they confirm may be public: everyone can see it.

slots.ask: What do you offer? For each: a name, how long or how often, a starting price if you publish one, and one line on the outcome.
slots.write: tag = format · price, only if they publish prices; title = the service name; description = the outcome for the client, not the activity.

slots.ask: Do you have two or three short client quotes you have permission to publish?
slots.write: Each quote verbatim, with name and role as the client approved. Never write or polish a quote.

slots.ask: Are there case studies or projects you can link to?
slots.write: tag = client, only if named publicly; title = the result in a few words.

slots.ask: Which professional profiles or newsletter should be linked?
slots.write: Account URLs only; a label and description only for their own pages.
